text:
dana: Quick run-through before the A/B price rollout tomorrow. Need final confirmation on refund windows, journal treatment for credits, and partner handoff wording.

omar: Refund windows: auto-credit for invoices paid within 21 days; manual refund if >21 days or credit > $2,000 USD. Keeps AR workload manageable.

dana: Sounds good. How do we post the credit in ledger? We post a credit memo reducing AR and record a contra-revenue JV for the adjustment, right?

chloe: Yes: create credit memo referencing original invoice number, post contra-revenue (GL 4200) and AR reduction (GL 1100). Finance will need CSV with original invoice, credit_memo_id, amount_usd, gl_codes.

omar: I'll add `gl_contra_revenue=4200` and `gl_ar=1100` columns to the export. SQL for the cohort:```sql
select c.customer_id, i.invoice_id, i.amount_usd, s.created_at as sub_created
from subscriptions s
join invoices i on i.subscription_id = s.id
where s.created_at < '2026-03-01' and i.status='paid' and i.issue_date >= '2026-02-01';
```

partner-ops: Marketplace note: for partner-billed accounts we can't create platform credit memos. Recommend handoff csv with `partner_account_id`, `customer_id`, `invoice_id`, `recommended_credit_usd`, and suggested partner message. We'll ask partners to confirm within 5 business days.

dana: For partner passthroughs, we will also offer a small platform promo (non-financial ledger) equal to up to $50 so the customer sees immediate relief while partner processes formal refund. Add flag `promo_issued=true` for those rows.

chloe: Draft email copy for customers receiving credit memo: "We adjusted your invoice as part of a pricing experiment. A credit of $X has been applied to your account (Credit Memo #CM-XXXX). It will appear on your next invoice. Contact billing@redwood.com for questions." I'll include VAT/tax language for EU rows.

finance-bot: Export queued at 02:30 UTC. Expected rows: ~1,100 platform-billed, ~320 partner-billed. File: https://internal.redwood/exports/2002345678-rollout-ledger-export.csv

dana: Action items: Omar run export + include GL columns; Chloe add VAT columns and email copy; Partner-ops prepare handoff template and SLA; I'll finalize refund thresholds with CFO. Locking plan at 17:00 PT if no objections.

omar: Running export now. Will tag `experiment_ab=true` and `refund_policy=auto_credit_21d`.

partner-ops: Received, will prepare partner template and SLA doc.

finance-bot: Job started 02:33 UTC - export uploaded.
